## Advancing technology education research

CATER is an emerging international network for advancing technology education research through shared tools, methodological development, research synthesis, and capacity-building.

The network is built around a simple premise: technology education research needs shared infrastructure. This includes better tools, stronger methods, clearer evidence, and more sustained international collaboration.

## Core areas

### Research credibility

Supporting more robust, transparent, and cumulative technology education research.

### Research tools

Developing and sharing tools for assessment, analysis, synthesis, and methodological innovation.

### Capacity-building

Providing training, resources, and networked support for technology education researchers.
